summary: Decision Audit Log (P1 learning foundation) end-to-end verified. Backend: 11/11 unit tests pass (test_procurement_audit.py — fake-collection coverage of upsert/idempotency/interaction/link/finalize/stats/tenant). 13/13 NEW live integration tests pass (test_procurement_audit_api.py — auth, filter validation, /recommendations hook + perf, idempotency, /audit/stats shape, full lifecycle e2e (recommendations → 3 events → save_suggestion → PATCH outcome=acted_on → audit finalized), suggestion_opened_at NOT overwritten on re-stamp, cross-tenant isolation between demo and tenant_iso_test). Regression: 40/40 pre-existing tests pass across test_procurement_inbox_outcome.py + test_procurement_api.py + test_procurement_decisions.py (1 unrelated guardrail skip). One transient ConnectTimeout in the full run on test_target_price_lifecycle — re-run passed; flaky network only, NOT an audit defect.
critical_code_review_comments: services/procurement_audit.py — record_recommendation_generated query keys on (restaurant_id, canonical_product_id, recommendation_type, status in [open, interacted]). Idempotent upsert proven on live tenant: 2 sequential GET /recommendations calls produced ZERO new audit rows (count stable). Confidence/risk/generation_count refresh in place — verified.

record_interaction first stamps the timestamp via {field: None} guard then refreshes status/suggestion_id/updated_at unconditionally. Live test confirmed: second suggestion_opened call did NOT overwrite suggestion_opened_at. Correct first-occurrence-only semantics.

finalize_outcome prefers suggestion_id match (strongest link) and falls back to (cpid, rec_type, status∈{open,interacted}). Edge case where audit row is missing creates a minimal finalized record so the dataset stays complete — covered by unit test_finalize_outcome_creates_minimal_record_when_missing.

All audit hook calls in services/procurement_decisions.py and services/procurement_suggestions.py are wrapped try/except as documented — verified by induction: live /recommendations + save + PATCH all return 200 cleanly, audit writes succeed, no 500s observed.

routes/procurement_audit.py validates filters server-side against fixed allow-lists and raises 400 on bogus values — verified for status, recommendation_type, outcome_type, confidence_level (case sensitivity enforced for confidence_level: 'high' lowercase rejected, 'High' accepted). Good fail-fast.
Tenant isolation: all audit reads scope strictly by user['restaurant_id']. Live test on demo (large dataset) and tenant_iso_test (empty) returned ZERO shared event_ids. No cross-tenant leakage.
list_audit_events and find_one all use {'_id': 0} projection — no Mongo ObjectId leakage in the API surface.
Performance: GET /api/procurement/recommendations completed in ~1.5s on demo tenant — well under the 5s budget. Audit upsert hooks add no measurable regression.

aggregate_audit_stats response shape exactly matches spec: {total, open, interacted, finalized, by_recommendation_type:{switch_vendor|renegotiate|no_action|monitor_only:{generated, acted_on, not_pursued, acted_on_rate, not_pursued_rate}}, high_confidence_not_pursued:[...], sample_queries:{switch_vendor_acted_on_rate, high_confidence_not_pursued_count}}. Verified live.

MINOR (NOT a defect): list_audit_events accepts limit up to 2000 but aggregate_audit_stats hard-codes limit=2000. For tenants exceeding 2000 audit rows, stats will silently truncate. Acceptable for MVP / learning-foundation scale; flag for future paged aggregation.
